summary: Multi-fold h=60 training attempt. Tested raw-unit LightGBM and Ridge on non-COVID fold-3 train, evaluated on non-zero val rows. h=60 fold-3 has 35 non-zero val rows. Folds 1 and 2 provide ~90 rows each. ML did not beat old Optuna champion (MAE=46.112 vs floor=40.042). State updated with h60 champion entry (beats_old_champion=false). h=60 final champion is still the best naive predictor: naive_h60_seasonal_median_w26 (the baseline floor, MAE=40.042), since NO ML has beaten the floor for h=60.

findings.anchor_correct_h60_mae_fold3: ~46.1 (worse than floor — target-DOW anchor hurt for h=60)
findings.best_ml_mae_fold3: >46 (does not beat Optuna champion at 46.112 or floor at 40.042)
findings.conclusion: No ML model beats floor for h=60. Champion is naive_h60_seasonal_median_w26 (floor itself).

handoff.read_this_first: h=60 ML does not beat floor (40.042). Champion for h=60 is the naive baseline predictor naive_h60_seasonal_median_w26 — use it as-is in end_model (no ML refit needed). anchor_correct_h60 (target-DOW) is actually WORSE than the origin-DOW naive predictor for h=60 and should not be used.

durable_rules.rule: For h=60, the serving prediction is naive_h60_seasonal_median_w26 (smedian of last 26 same-DOW observations using ORIGIN DOW, not target DOW). Do not use anchor_correct_h60.
durable_rules.why: anchor_correct_h60 (target-DOW) gave MAE=46.112 vs naive_h60_seasonal_median_w26 (origin-DOW) at MAE=40.042. The target-DOW anchor is worse for h=60 — the 60-day DOW shift causes the anchor to use a different DOW whose recent history is less predictive.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: h=60 predictions would be ~6 units worse than the naive floor, creating avoidable degradation.

methodological_cautions.caution: For h=60, anchor_correct (target-DOW) is WORSE than the origin-DOW naive predictor. The DOW-correction that helps h=1 and h=30 hurts h=60.
methodological_cautions.why: h=60 is 8 weeks and 4 days. The DOW shift means origin Monday targets a Friday 60 days later. The Friday same-DOW history (26 Fridays back) covers a narrower and less stable demand pattern than 26 Mondays back.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Would deploy an anchor_correct predictor for h=60 that performs 6+ MAE units worse than the floor.

do_not_repeat.tried: ML models (LightGBM raw units, Ridge) for h=60
do_not_repeat.evidence: Best ML MAE > 46 vs floor 40.042 on fold-3 (35 non-zero val rows)
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: Insufficient post-regime data relative to horizon length; 35 val rows is marginal.
do_not_repeat.reopen_if: New data with more post-regime observations, or feature engineering that explicitly models the regime shift.

do_not_repeat.why_not_again: Target-DOW anchor is worse than origin-DOW anchor for h=60 due to DOW mismatch in demand patterns.
do_not_repeat.reopen_if: Never — the floor predictor IS the origin-DOW anchor.

content_carried_forward.h60_note: Champion IS the floor — no ML improvement found.
